quantization.type: post-training static INT8, not additional training job

performance.protocol: CPU inference only; identical preloaded FP32 inputs, threads, batch sizes and repeats; warmup excluded; model order alternates; includes FX/fusion effects.

calibration.input_transform: deterministic evaluation RGB normalization; no random augmentation

quantization.boundary: Latency/throughput only on logged CPU/threads/batch; does not reduce original architecture parameter count or establish GPU speed.

not_claimed: No exhaustive combinations or independent full-budget tuning for every method.
No hidden test labels or external weights/data.
Three-view AugMix+JSD was considered but not trained; executed AugMix was single-view torchvision variant.
Depth/kernel/batch comparisons may co-vary width/LR to respect budget; do not call all causal single-variable ablations.
CPU FP32 scores must not be mixed with trainer BF16 selected scores. Author-recipe trainer used amp none.
SWA/EMA are alternate weights in a run, not extra trained models for job counting.
Finishing400 or stopping an authorized comparison does not establish global convergence.
Official public/private feedback is maintained separately by the report owner; this evidence file verifies training and local validation only, not current leaderboard scores.
official_scores_scope: Official public/private results are maintained in a separate verified submission table, not inferred from local validation.
